items.title: HackMe OS ISO published (956 MB) · SHA256 verified · pool ~2.4 GH/s
items.summary: Bootable HackMe-OS-0.1.0-rc11g-amd64.iso built and verified: Zero-Knowledge Start, production pool token embedded, minersign + workerpoh in image. Full test sweep + chaos guard PASS. ISO SHA256: 1b7bd70e381bb0d5aee82135fe01963d27d2af43ebfba95e02dec22aabe17658. Deploy to hackme.tech/dist with scripts/ops/deploy_release_rc11g_iso.sh.
items.impact: Miners can flash Etcher USB and join the public pool with no wallet setup; operators publish ISO via VPS rsync.
items.action: Verify: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-iso.txt · Flash ISO · Pool stats: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/work/stats · BCT: docs/BITCOINTALK_UPDATE_HACKME_OS_BBCode.txt

items.title: Zero-Knowledge Start · HackMe OS on downloads · Windows worker watchdog
items.summary: HackMe OS: flash USB, boot — empty hackme.ini triggers auto HMC wallet + 24-word recovery phrase on screen, then instant pool mining (no config). New downloads section for the live ISO. Windows installer ships worker watchdog (mining stays up after GPU crashes). Site + manifests updated.
items.impact: Miners can start in zero seconds on ISO rigs; Windows rigs auto-restart the pool worker; official ISO and checksums appear on hackme.tech/downloads when the build is published.
items.action: Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html#hackme-os · Windows: HackMe-Setup exe · ISO docs: https://github.com/jokeez/hackme/blob/main/docs/HACKME_OS.md · Pool: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/work/stats

items.title: Ecosystem dashboard · nightly chaos guard · HackMe OS miner ISO
items.summary: Desktop dashboard home is now the Ecosystem coin table (Hive-style): live HMC pool stats, clickable mining entry, roadmap slots for future chains. Nightly chaos guard tests 5000 payout ledger drift, HTTP replay/tamper (403), and HackMe OS init-worker.ini hardening. HackMe OS live USB build: CPU isolation, RT scheduler, GPU performance mode, fair pool worker autostart.
items.impact: Miners get a clearer pool-first UI; operators get automated security regression tests; Linux rigs can boot a dedicated HackMe OS image pointed at hackme.tech pool.
items.action: Pull latest main · Dashboard: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (Ecosystem tab) · Pool: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/work/stats · Docs: docs/HACKME_OS.md · Chaos tests: bash scripts/tests/nightly_chaos_guard.sh

items.title: Coordinator stress test passed · Bitcointalk update · MiningPoolStats listing
items.summary: 10-minute mega stress: 100 virtual workers, 0% hard errors, no coordinator crash, RAM stable (~12→20 MB), halving at block 2,102,401 verified (0.01→0.005 HMC). Malformed ingress and chaos disconnects handled cleanly. Public pool on hackme.tech — HTTP coordinator (not Stratum). Bitcointalk ANN updated; MiningPoolStats submission in progress.
items.impact: Miners can trust coordinator stability under load; follow the official ANN thread for setup. OpenCL Windows builds (rc11g) and live pool stats unchanged.
items.action: Read the update on Bitcointalk: https://bitcointalk.org/index.php?topic=5583373.0 · Pool stats: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/pool/stats · Downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · Stress harness in repo: scripts/tests/coordinator_mega_stress.sh

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11g: Windows OpenCL worker (AMD RX 580 full GPU)
items.summary: Windows bundle now ships workerpoh-opencl.exe (mingw cross-build). AMD Radeon rigs use native OpenCL instead of CPU-only ~0.02 GH/s. Tested on RX 580 2048SP: ~0.12+ GH/s in pool (vs ~0.021 CPU). Rig profile keeps opencl when the binary is present.
items.impact: Windows AMD miners get real GPU mining in one installer; pool token and amd_rx580_2048sp profile unchanged.
items.action: Download HackMe-Setup-0.1.0-rc11g.exe · Existing installs: copy workerpoh-opencl.exe next to hackme.exe and set HACKME_GPU_BACKEND=opencl, or reinstall rc11g.

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11f: Windows CP1251 fix + pool token repair
items.summary: Installer and scripts use ASCII-only PowerShell (Russian Windows no longer breaks detect_gpu / write_hackme_env). Auto-repair hackme.env from pool.miner.token on miner start. RX 580 2048SP rig profile applied when GPU is detected. Pool live ~69 GH/s, M ~143M.
items.impact: Windows miners on RU locales: install and Start HackMe Miner without PowerShell parse errors; pool token and amd_rx580_2048sp profile written reliably.
items.action: Download HackMe-Setup-0.1.0-rc11f.exe from https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · Existing installs: run start_hackme_miner.bat (repairs env) or reinstall rc11f.

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11e: Windows installer + GPU wizard + pool token fix
items.summary: Official HackMe-Setup.exe (Inno Setup) replaces zip-only onboarding: Program Files install, Start menu/desktop shortcuts, registry entries, preconfigured pool token. Wizard page detects GPU (Auto / NVIDIA CUDA / AMD OpenCL / CPU). Rig profiles for RX 580 2048SP. Fixes Program Files path quoting and hackme.env repair from pool.miner.token.
items.impact: Windows miners: one .exe install, no manual token hunt. Pool ~69 GH/s live; difficulty M auto-retargets. Dashboard shows per-worker GH/s and HMC accrual.
items.action: Download HackMe-Setup-0.1.0-rc11e.exe from https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · AMD RX 580: choose Auto or OpenCL in installer · Pool stats: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/pool/stats

items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc10: native NVIDIA CUDA + AMD/Intel OpenCL
items.summary: Linux bundle adds workerpoh-cuda (NVRTC, Blackwell compute_120), honest pool hashrate calibration (~80–120 GH/s on RTX 50), and GPU backend auto-detect. Windows zip: hackme.exe + workerpoh-opencl.exe. Docs: GPU_MINING_BACKENDS.md, CUDA_PRODUCTION.md.
items.impact: NVIDIA miners should use CUDA on Linux for full GPU throughput; AMD/Intel use OpenCL. Pool stats and payouts reflect measured GH/s.
items.action: Download 0.1.0-rc10 from https://hackme.tech/downloads.html · Linux NVIDIA: HACKME_GPU_BACKEND=cuda · See docs/GPU_MINING_BACKENDS.md

items.title: Pool fairness: GPU-weighted limits, faster settlement, MPS prep
items.summary: Coordinator now caps paid attempts by measured GH/s (stops CPU submit-spam), limits claim/submit rate per worker, and settlement runs every ~30s. Dashboard calculator slider fixed; unpaid accrual display syncs from hackme.tech. MiningPoolStats listing checklist + exchange roadmap docs added. Desktop miners: use batch 4M + OpenCL/CUDA; remote VPS workers should use worker token (not full admin).
items.impact: Your PC GPU rig should earn proportionally to hashrate; payouts above min threshold reach on-chain faster. Public stats: https://hackme.tech/pool/coordinator/api/pool/stats
items.action: Pull latest from GitHub · Restart pool worker after update · MPS: docs/MININGPOOLSTATS_LISTING.md · Fair tuning: scripts/ops/apply_desktop_gpu_pool.sh

items.title: Advanced mining calculator in node dashboard
items.summary: The embedded dashboard (Mining tab) now includes a live mining calculator: hashrate → HMC/hour, PoH ETA, found-bonus estimates, electricity ROI, break-even, and pool vs chain-empty comparison. Params sync from /api/work/stats and /api/metrics (reward/M, target_mod, pool GH/s). Presets: your worker, pool average, GPU/CPU rigs.
items.impact: Miners can model payout and power costs before joining the pool or scaling rigs — no spreadsheet required.
items.action: Open your node dashboard → Mining tab → Mining calculator. Public pool: https://hackme.tech/pool/ — downloads: https://hackme.tech/downloads.html

items.title: Security rewards program — small HMC bug bounty
items.summary: Private security and UI reports can earn discretionary on-chain HMC after verified fixes. Tiers are modest (roughly 1–200 HMC per issue, ~200 HMC/month program cap) — not investment income. Full policy on security-rewards.html and GitHub docs/BUG_BOUNTY.md.
items.impact: Researchers and miners know how to report without public 0-days; rewards stay aligned with treasury economics.
